why_this_one: The Saint Statue of Blood Castle 1 carries it over its coffin (ZzzCharacter.cpp:8952-8966) and gives it up when broken; carried back to the Archangel it wins the castle (the user, 2026-10-03). A quest item, worn by nobody.

stats.from: WebZen item.txt group 5 (the Data/lang/main/item.txt of the 1.00.93 server files): 10 0 0 1 4 1 1 1 'Divine Staff of Archangel' 104 153 165 30 0 182 156 0 36 4 0 0 0 0 | DW 1, DK 0, Elf 0, MG 1, DL 0. OpenMU S6 Weapons.cs:252 agrees.
stats.note: A quest item here (the user, 2026-10-03: 'we need that archange staff is quest item and its not ussable for any char'): the Statue of Saint gives it up and the Archangel takes it back; nobody wears it (sim::divineStaff in fits), and its damage, magic power, requirements and class are left out so the card says none. WebZen's row was drop 104, 153-165, magic 156, wizard; it does not drop from monsters.
